summary: The code compiles and uses Playwright APIs mostly correctly but contains weak and placeholder selectors. Multiple assertions rely on a generic '[data-testid="filters"]' selector instead of specific product card or link selectors. Navigation validation is weak with no URL or content checks confirming the product detail page load. Comments indicate incomplete test implementation and missing assertions. Test case IDs are correctly preserved in titles.

issues.description: Selectors for product cards and product card links reuse the generic '[data-testid="filters"]' selector, which does not specifically target the intended elements and weakens test effectiveness.
issues.recommendation: Define specific, stable selectors for product cards and product links to ensure precise targeting and reliable tests.

issues.description: Test TC-003 lacks explicit assertions verifying successful navigation to the product detail page, such as URL checks or detail content validation.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions verifying the URL or visible content changes after clicking a product card to confirm that the product detail page is loaded.

issues.description: Test TC-002 contains comments indicating missing assertions for product image, name, and price, resulting in incomplete test coverage.
issues.recommendation: Implement the additional assertions to check that product card details are fully validated.

recommendations: Refine selectors to be more specific and stable to avoid flakiness.
Complete implementation of assertions for product details in TC-002.
Add navigation validation in TC-003 by asserting URL or page content changes.
Ensure all placeholders and comments are resolved before final test deployment.
